request: Analyze GSE233004 for PMID 38686869 (Moderate Endurance Exercise Increases Arrhythmia Susceptibility and Modulates Cardiac Structure and Function in a Sexually Dimorphic Manner.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.sample_inclusion: 3 sedentary + 3 exercised LV per sex, n=12 (S1.7.p1, FIG6 legend)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week moderate treadmill endurance exercise on LV gene expression, estimated separately within each sex (exercised vs sedentary)
planned_contrasts: Female EX vs Female Sed (FIG6B/C; S2.5.p2: 1 DEG, Ddx3y up in EX)
Male EX vs Male Sed (FIG6B/D; S2.5.p2: 22 DEGs)
Female vs Male within Sed (FIG7; 896 DEGs) and within EX (174 DEGs) -- sex comparisons, not exercise estimands
final.repeated_measure_unit: none for RNA-seq (one heart per mouse)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test, BH-adjusted p (S1.8.p3), per-sex exercised vs sedentary comparison

paper_threshold.source_locator: S1.8.p3 (Padj < 0.05; log2FC cutoff 0 for volcano/KEGG; 2 only for top-gene plots); FIG6 legend

final.paper_direction_convention: log2FC = Sedentary minus Exercised (S1.7.p1); positive = up in Sed. Our tables use EX vs SED (positive = up in EX).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S1.7.p1 and S1.8.p3 define DESeq2 Wald + BH, padj<0.05; the DEG counts quoted in S2.5.p2 come from the volcano plots, whose log2FC cutoff is 0 (S1.8.p3). The exercise question is answered per sex in Figure 6; Figure 7 is sex-difference, not exercise.

design.reasoning: Paper FIG6 compares exercised with sedentary mice within each sex (n=3 vs 3), using DESeq2 (S1.7.p1, S1.8.p3). The paper does not say whether each sex was fitted separately; the standard DESeq2 workflow for a 4-group study is one model on all 12 samples (~ group) with per-sex contrasts. A first attempt with separate per-sex fits gave 24 (F) / 0 (M) DEGs against the paper's 1 / 22, while one 4-group model gives 1 / 26 and reproduces Ddx3y as the only female DEG, so the joint 4-group model is taken as the paper's route and the separate fits are kept as sensitivity.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one LV each; no batch, lane or date recorded in GEO or the paper. Sex is balanced with treatment (3/3 in each sex), so it is not confounded.

deviations: pydeseq2 rather than R DESeq2; independent filtering/Cook's outlier handling may differ slightly

threshold.reasoning: S1.8.p3: Padj < 0.05, log2FC cutoff 0 for volcano/KEGG (the DEG counts). The |log2FC| > 2 rule applied only to the top-gene panels and is kept as a labelled audit rule.

caveats: Paper's log2FC sign is Sed minus EX; ours is EX minus Sed.

Ddx3y (Y-linked) reported up in exercised females; female samples carry low Ddx3y counts (FEX 14-26 vs FSE 0-5) while Xist is uniformly high in females, so this looks like low-level male-read contamination or cross-mapping, not a sex mislabel.
